decision: FAIL: total-byte gate missed; generic PCA matches; compute regression and independent-task boundary
facts: Aligned: Mirror 16,727 B, NRMSE 7.39e-6; direct independent coordinates 20,624 B / 3.90e-7; generic PCA 17,018 B / 2.89e-7.
Mirror total-payload saving vs direct is 18.9%, below frozen 20% gate; task adaptation state is 309 B vs 4,206 B direct (~92.7% smaller).
Mirror fit uses 800 updates / 3,276,800 example presentations and ~0.463 s; direct coordinate fitting uses 4,096 support examples once and ~0.00357 s.
Independent tasks: direct NRMSE ~3.94e-7, Mirror ~0.971, PCA ~0.910.
interpretation: Amortizing the shared U over 64 aligned tasks makes task-code savings substantial but total bytes still miss the gate because U dominates. Generic PCA is nearly as compact and slightly more accurate with no iterative optimization. The Mirror orbit does not represent independent task coordinates.
hypothesis: Not supported as a practical Mirror-specific Pareto improvement under the preregistered thresholds. Task-state compression alone does not deliver enough total storage savings here, and compute worsens markedly.
counter_hypothesis: Larger task counts or a smaller/preexisting U amortization could move the total-byte frontier; an analytic fit could remove optimization cost. Not tested in this candidate.
limitations: Synthetic linear tasks and random frozen projection
Aligned teacher generated from Givens orbit
N=64 only; no larger scaling curve
No pretrained LM, natural task, inference latency or training convergence study
